description: A project's environments, in order, and its ten newest deployments. An environment is one of the places a project's work is put out to — 'dev', 'staging', 'prod' — in order; the LAST one is where finished work ends up. A deployment is a pipeline saying «this went out, there». Each issue it carried then says where it lies ('deployedTo' on get_issue), gets one history line per environment, and the project's rules with trigger 'deployed' run on it. Also 'canEdit' (you may change the list) and 'canReport' (you may report a deployment). Any member may read them.
name: list_environments
